messages:
support_jordan: Customer reports intermittent OAuth failure — callback arrives with an empty code param. Example: https://app.redwood.com/auth/callback?code=&state=Zxy+9AB%3D
customer_jane: Yep. Happens ~1/5 attempts. Started after we flipped traffic to eu-west proxy. Chrome & Safari.
eng_miguel: Which provider? can you paste the raw redirect you see (copy from address bar)?
customer_jane: GitHub SSO. Raw redirect (copied): https://app.redwood.com/auth/callback?code=&state=Zxy+9AB%3D. Steps: click Sign in with GitHub -> consent -> redirect -> code empty. Cleared cookies, incognito same.
sre_leila: Quick hypothesis: proxy/CDN is normalizing querystring — turning encoded plus (+) into space. That could break state/PKCE validation or confuse the provider. Do you have access logs/headers?
customer_jane: Pasted a snippet: request_id=rid-83b path=/auth/callback query_string='code=&state=Zxy 9AB=' upstream=10.1.12.5:443 x-forwarded-for=203.0.113.12
support_jordan: That log shows the '+' got converted to space before hitting the app. If state is mutated, our state check will fail. In some flows provider will then not return a usable code.
eng_miguel: I'll try to reproduce locally with our edge rules. Hold on, tailing logs...
deploy-bot: deploy to staging queued (id: deploy-1777)
eng_miguel: Repro'd in staging. The CDN rewrite step decodes querystring, then re-encodes but treats '+' as literal space. Github uses '+' in state tokens sometimes. Outcome: state arrives as 'Zxy 9AB=' which fails our validation -> we see empty code in redirect.
sre_leila: I think the EU edge rewrite rule added a decode/normalize step last week. Quick mitigation: roll back that rewrite or change it to preserve the raw query string. I can hotfix the edge config.
support_jordan: Customer can we try again if we rollback?
customer_jane: Yep we can retry now.
sre_leila: Rolling back EU rewrite for routing group eu-west -> rollback applied at 1777777830.
customer_jane: Tried again — sign in SUCCESS, code param present, tokens issued. Thanks! :tada:
support_jordan: Great. We'll keep this thread open to track a permanent fix.
eng_miguel: Action items: 1) revert decode/normalize in CDN rewrite (done), 2) add a guard in edge that preserves '+' as %2B, 3) add a defensive fallback in auth callback: if code empty and state looks like it lost '+' -> try re-encoding spaces to %2B and validate (short-term), 4) infra ticket created: INFRA-1234 for permanent test & deploy.
sre_leila: I'll push the config patch to staging and run the regression test suite for auth redirects. ETA tomorrow.
support_jordan: Marking customer update: resolved for now, will follow up after INFRA-1234. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
